name: Vicious
body:
Like the mightiest of asterion heroes, you can attack with such vigor you hurt yourself.

Prerequisite: Asterion, Con 15, BAB +1.

Benefit: Whenever you make a melee attack, you may choose to deal an additional 2d4 points of damage on a successful hit. Whenever you do this, you also deal 1d4 damage to yourself. The damage you take from this feat bypasses all defenses, protections, DR, and effects that reduce the damage you would take.
